<entry id="N01312">
<head-word>נְשִׁיכָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נָשַׁךְ) 
<italic>biting, bite</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Mekh. Mishp., N’ziḳin, s. 12; Y. B. Kam. I, beg. 2
<sup>a</sup>. Bab. ib. 2
<sup>b</sup> נ' תולדה דשן היא is not biting a species of damage by the tooth? Ab. II, 10 נְשִׁיכָתָן נְשִׁיכַת וכ' their (the scholars’) bite is the bite of a fox; a. e.—[Y. Ter. VI, end, 44
<sup>b</sup> נשיכת פיאה, read נשירת, v. נְשִׁירָה.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01313">
<head-word>נְשִׁילָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נָשַׁל) 
<italic>falling off, chopping off; dropping</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Macc. II, beg. 31
<sup>c</sup> מה נ' שנ' להלן נשירה וכ' as the verb 
<italic>nashal</italic> there (Deut. XXVIII, 40) means dropping, so here it means (ib. XIX, 5) the slipping (of the iron from the helve). Ib. מה נ' שנ' להלן מכה וכ' as well as 
<italic>nashal</italic> there (Deut. VII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes> means striking (diminishing), so here it means (Deut. XIX, 5) striking (the iron will cause a chip to fly off the wood). Koh. R. to IX, 12 בנְשִׁילַת אברים they died from decaying limbs; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01314">
<head-word>נְשִׁימָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נָשַׁם) 
<italic>breath</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 16
<sup>b</sup> צריך למימרינהו בנ' אחת you must recite them (the names of the sons of 
<pgbrk id="pg940" />Haman) in one breath; (Y. ib. III, 74
<sup>b</sup> bot. בנפיחה). Gen. R. s. 14, end (ref. to כל הנשמה, Ps. CL, 6) על כל נ' ונ' שאדם נושם וכ' for every breath that one takes one must praise &c.; Deut. R. s. 2, end.—[Tanḥ. R’eh 9, v. next w.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes> Tanh., ed. Bub., R’eh 3 מתו בנ' אחת they died from one current of wind; Tanḥ. ib. 9 בנשימה (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01318">
<head-word>נְשִׁיקָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> נָשַׁק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>kissing, kiss</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 70; Ex. R. s. 5, a. e. נ' של גדולה the kiss of homage; נ' של פרקים the kiss of meeting again; נ' של פרישות the kiss of parting; נ' של קריבות the kissing of relations. Deut. R. s. 11, end ונטל … בנְשִׁיקַת פה and took his (Moses’) soul with a kiss of the mouth. B. Bath. 17
<sup>a</sup> מרים נמי בנ' מתה Miriam, likewise, died with a (divine) kiss (without agony); M. Kat. 28
<sup>a</sup>. Ber. 8
<sup>a</sup> נ' דמיא וכ' death without agony is like taking &c., v. בִּינְתָא II; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נְשִׁיקוֹת</plural-form>. Ex. R. l. c. Cant. R. to I, 2 מה"ש אמרוהו יתן לנו מנ' וכ' the ministering angels said the verse, ‘May he give us of those kisses which he gave to his sons’ (at Mount Sinai). Ib. בסיני נאמרה יוציא לנו נ' מתוך פיהו at Mount Sinai the verse was said (by the Israelites), ‘May he let kisses go forth to us out of his mouth’; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>contact of sexual membra</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 55
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01322">
<head-word>נְשִׁירָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (נָשַׁר) 
<italic>falling off, dropping</italic> (of fruits).</definition>
<notes> Y. Macc. II, beg. 31
<sup>c</sup>, v. נְשׁילָה. Y. Peah II, 20
<sup>a</sup> bot. פרט בנְשִׁירָתוֹ קדש the dropping grapes are dedicated (to charity, cease to be private property) at the moment of dropping (before they reach the ground). Ib. לקט בנשירתו וכ' if one intercepts the grapes in falling &c.; Y. Ter. VI, end, 44
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. בנשיכת פיאה וכ', read: בנְשִׁירַת פרט it refers to grapes intercepted in falling. Tem. 25
<sup>a</sup> אמר על הלקט עם נשירת רובו וכ' if he said concerning gleanings, As soon as the larger portion of them drops (before they reach the ground) they shall be free to all (הֶפְקֵר); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<xref rid="N01348">נֶשֶׁר II</xref>)

<entry id="N01325">
<head-word>נָשַךְ</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. נשק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bite</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 74, beg. שאינן נוֹשְׁכִין ואוכלין וכ' they do not bite off and eat, but out &c.; Pesik. Par., p. 34
<sup>a</sup>; Koh. R. to VII, 23. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVII אל תהי קורא וישקהו אלא וַיִּשָּׁכֵהוּ read not, ‘and he kissed him’ (Gen. XXXIII, 4) but, ‘and he bit him.’ Tosef. B. Kam. I, 5 אינה מועדת … לִישּׁוֹךְ is not considered as forewarned (v. מוּעָד) as regards … biting; a. fr.—Part. pass. נָשׁוּךְ, f. נְשׁוּכָה &c. Num. R. s. 20 רופא … בלשונו נְשׁוּךְ נחש a physician that comes to heal with his tongue (charm) one bitten by a serpent. Ter. VIII, 6 נְשׁוּכַת הנחש וכ' any food showing traces of being bitten at by a serpent is forbidden &c.; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to adhere to, be affixed</italic>. Pes. 48
<sup>b</sup> ככרות … שנוֹשְׁכוֹת זו מזו Babylonian loaves which stick to one another; T’bul Yom I, 1 נושכות זו בזו; Ḥall. II, 4 עד שיִשּׁוֹכוּ (
<italic>Nif.</italic>) until the pieces of dough have grown together in rising, contrad. to נגע. Sabb. 17
<sup>a</sup> הנושכות clusters of grapes which stick together (and cannot be separated without squeezing some grapes open); a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Y. Ḥall. I, 57
<sup>b</sup> בנ' if refers to pieces of dough sticking together, contrad. to בלול kneaded. Ib. III, 59
<sup>c</sup> top עיסת הנ' dough made one lump by sticking; נ' מאליו sticking together of itself (by rising), opp. הִשִּׁיכוֹ בידו he pasted it together with his hand. Ib. 58
<sup>b</sup> bot., sq. הנָ' תורה the liability to T’rumah, Ḥallah &c. of joined lumps of dough is Biblical law. Y. Kil. IX, end, 32
<sup>d</sup> אין אסור אלא נ' בלבד the combination of heterogeneous materials (כִּלְאַיִם) is forbidden only when they are interlaced. Ib. וההן נו נ', v. נוּ.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of נֶשֶׁךְ) 
<italic>to take interest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. V, 1; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִישֵּׁךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, 
<italic>to bite</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 78 לנַשְּׁכוֹ to bite him. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 4 וינַשְּׁכֶנּוּ and may bite him; a. e.—Part. pass. מְנוּשָּׁךְ. Tosef. B. Kam. III, 6 או מ' or he is found to have been bitten.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשִּׁיךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to bite</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. IX, 1 ה' בו וכ' he brought the serpent near him to bite him, contrad. to שיסה to set on. Ib. 78
<sup>a</sup>; B. Kam. 23
<sup>b</sup>, v. נָכַשׁ. Y. Yeb. VIII, 9
<sup>b</sup> top [read:] מביא נמלין ומַשִּׁיכָן וקוצץ he gets ants and makes them bite (the open wound) and cuts their bodies off (and so the gap is filled), v. Bab. ib. 76
<sup>a</sup>.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to paste or press together</italic>. Y. Ḥall. III, 59
<sup>c</sup> top, v. מביא ארבע רובעין ומַשִּׁיךְ he takes four lumps of dough which joined contain four fourths of a Kab and presses them together into one lump; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pay interest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 70
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXIII, 21) מאי תשיך לאו תִּשּׁוֹךְ לא תַּשִּׁיךְ what is meant by 
<italic>tashshikh?</italic> Does it not mean thou mayest (or must) take interest? No, it means, thou mayest (or must) pay him interest.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01326">
<head-word>נֶשֶׁךְ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) [
<italic>bite</italic>, trnsf., cmp. חִבּוּלְיָא) 
<italic>usury, interest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. V, 1 איזהו נ' המלוה וכ' what is 
<italic>neshekh?</italic> If one loans a Sela stipulating the debt at five Denars, contrad. to תַּרְבִּית. Ib. 60
<sup>b</sup> נ' איכא דקא נכית וכ' in this case it is 
<italic>neshekh</italic>, for he bites (injures the debtor) by receiving what he had not given him; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N01328">
<head-word>נָשַׁל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. שָׁלָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strike off, chip</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Macc. II, 6 נ' הברזל מן העץ המתבקע if the iron (axe) chipped a piece off the wood which was to be split (and the chip struck a person dead); v. נְשִׁילָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to slip off, fall off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 22 נָשְׁלוּ איבריו his limbs fell off (by decay; Gen. 
<pgbrk id="pg941" />R. s. 10 נָשְׁרוּ; Koh. R. to V, 8 נשרן, נשרין, ch.). Macc. 7
<sup>b</sup> ונָשַׁל קרינן, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִישֵּׁל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to strike off, to cause chips to fly off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. ונִישֵּׁל כתיב 
<italic>v’nashal</italic> (Deut. XIX, 5) may be read 
<italic>v’nishshel</italic> (
<italic>Pi.</italic>) and the iron chips off a part of the wood &c., v. supra; ונָשַׁל קרינן the traditional reading is 
<italic>v’nashal</italic>, and the iron slips out of the helve (v. אֵם).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִישָּׁל, נִישּׁוֹל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to fall off, decay</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 37, end שהיה נ' ממנו אבר אבר וכ' limb after limb fell off his body and was buried each in a different place; ib. נ' אבר אבר; Koh. R. to X, 15; Gen. R. s. 60. Num. R. s. 9 יהא בשרה נ' her flesh (limbs) shall fall off; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשִּׁיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to let fall, drop</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. V, 1 מַשִּׁילִין פירות וכ' you may let down fruit (that was spread on the roof) through the aperture &c.; (versions ib. 35
<sup>b</sup>: משחילין, משירין, מנשירין, משחירין).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01331">
<head-word>נְשַׁם</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְנְשִׁים, אִינְּשַׁם, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִינַּשַּׁם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take breath, to rest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. B’shall., p. 93
<sup>a</sup> בעי את למִנַּשְּׁמָא וכ' wouldst thou rest a while?</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recover, get well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. XIV, 14
<sup>d</sup> bot.; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40
<sup>d</sup> לחש … וא' he whispered …, and the person recovered, v. יֵשׁוּ. Lam. R. to II, 11 כחול … ואת מִנַּשְּׁמָה use my eye-paint, and thou shalt get well. Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> bot. אִינַּשְּׁמַת it (the tooth) was cured; Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Gen. R. s. 33 אִתְנְשִׁימַת (some ed. אִתְנַשְּׁמִית I feel better). Lev. R. s. 9 רוקי … ואנא מִינְּשִׁים spit in my face seven times, and I shall be cured.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ittafel.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִינַּשְׁתֵּם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to breathe, to give signs of life</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 134
<sup>a</sup> האי … דלא מִינַּשְׁתֵּם Rashi a. Ms. O. (ed. מנשתי, מנשתיה; Rashi Ms. מִנְּשִׁים, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40; Ms. M. מנשתין) an infant which gives no signs of life.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="N01334">
<head-word>נְשָׁמָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>breath, spirit, soul</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 14, end, v. נֶפֶשׁ. Snh. 52
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. שריפת נ' וגוף וכ' burning of the breath of life while the body remains intact. Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48
<sup>c</sup> בחזקת שהנ' תלויה בו under the presumption that he is still alive. Y. B. Kam. VII, end, 6
<sup>a</sup> דבר שהנ' תלויה בו a part of an animal’s body the removal of which results in death; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נְשָׁמוֹת</plural-form>. Yeb. 62
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. גּוּף II. Sabb. 152

<senses>

<definition>

<sup>d</sup> (ref. to נשק, Ps. CXL, 8) ביום שהקיץ נוֹשֵׁק וכ' when the summer kisses the autumn (at the change of seasons, when disease is rife). Ib. ששני עולמות נוֹשְׁקִין וכ' when the two worlds touch eath other (the moment of death). Gen. R. s. 90, beg. (ref. to Gen. XLI, 40) שלא יהא אדם נוֹשְׁקֵינִי וכ' none shall kiss me (the kiss of homage) but thou. Ber. 8
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. כשנוֹשְׁקִין אין נושקין אלא וכ' when they (the Medians) kiss, they do so only on the hand. Yalk. Gen. 159 בדבר שהוא נוֹשְׁקוֹ על ערפו וכ' with a thing which one puts close to one’s neck, that is the bow; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. נָשׁוּק (cmp. אָחוּז fr. אָחַז) 
<italic>kissing</italic>. Sot. 42
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ruth I, 14) יבאו בני הנְשׁוּקָה … הדבוקה let the children of her that kissed (and parted) come and fall into the hands of the children of her who clung (to Naomi); Yalk. Sam. 156 הנְשֵׁיקָה … הדְּבֵקָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of נֶשֶׁק) 
<italic>to arm, equip</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to I, 2 (expl. ישקני, ib.) יזיינני יטהרני ידביקני may he arm me (ref. to I Chr. XII, 2), may he purify me (v. infra), may he attach me (ref. to Ezek. III, 13).</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to kiss</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. VII, 6 המְנַשֵּׁק he who kisses (an idol); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to arm, equip</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. מְנוּשָּׁק; f. 
<pgbrk id="pg942" />מְנוּשֶּׁקֶת, 
<plural-form>pl. מְנוּשָּׁקוֹת</plural-form>. Cant. R. l. c. אם עסקת … ששפתיך מנ' וכ' if thou studiest the words of the Law so that thy lips be equipped (ready for contest), all shall kiss thee &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשִּׁיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring in close contact, to close</italic> (lips).</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>d</sup> top יש דברים שמַשִּׁיקִין וכ' there are things on which you must seal your mouth (v. חָשַׁק).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (Levitical law) 
<italic>to restore a liquid to cleanness by contact or levelling with a clean well.</italic></definition>
<notes> Mikv. VI, 8 מביא … ומושכו ומַשִּׁיקוֹ he takes a pipe … and draws (the water from the clean pond) and makes it touch the surface of the unclean pond; Tosef. ib. V, 5. Cant. R. l. c. (expl. ישקני, may He cleanse me, v. supra) כאדם שהוא מַשִּׁיק וכ' as one brings in contact or levels &c., v. גֶּבֶא. Bets. II, 3 ושוין שמַשִּׁיקִין וכ' and they agree that you may (on the Holy Day) dip a vessel with an unclean liquid into a well so that the two surfaces are on a level, v. הַשָּׁקָה. Ḥull. 26
<sup>a</sup> sq. עד שלא החמיץ מַשִּׁיקוֹ וכ' before it is sour, you may cleanse it by levelling &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup> חייבו להַתִּיז וכ' he sentenced him to decapitation; Cant. R. to VII, 5; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to separate syllables</italic> or 
<italic>words distinctly, to articulate</italic> (
<italic>sybillants</italic>). Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>d</sup> צריך להתיז למען תזכרו (ed. Lehm. צריך לה' זי"ן וכ') you must articulate 
<italic>tiz-k’ru</italic> (emphasizing the 
<italic>zayin</italic>, Num. XV, 40). Ib. צריך לה' כי לעולם חסדו you must articulate 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>as-do</italic> (so as not to make it sound 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>asto</italic> or 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>azdo</italic>.—[Gitt. 70
<sup>a</sup> מַתִּיזִין גופו וכ' 
<italic>scatter</italic> the strength &c.; En Yaăk. מתישין.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)

<notes> Gitt. I, 6 תֵּן גט וכ' give this letter of divorce to my wife. Ib. תְּנוּ גט וכ' give ye &c. Ib. לא יִתְּנוּ לאחר מיתה they must not deliver it after the man’s death; a. v. fr.—נשא ונ', v. נָשָׂא.—נ' עיניו ל (to put an eye upon) 
<italic>to intend</italic>. B. Mets. 19
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. כיון שנ' ע' לגרשה as soon as he has resolved to divorce her; a. fr.—נ' עיניו ב (to have an eye on) 
<italic>to desire, think of</italic>. Ned. XI, 12 שלא תהא אשה נוֹתֶנֶת עיניה באחר lest the woman have a liking for another man. Ib. 20
<sup>b</sup> שלא אֶתֵּן עיני וכ' lest I think of another woman. Ib. אל ישתה … ויִתֵּן וכ' one must not drink of one cup (have connection with one woman) and think of another; a. fr.—Esp. נ' עיניו בו 
<italic>to cast an angry eye at, to hurt by an angry look</italic>. Ber. 58
<sup>a</sup> נ' ע' בו ונעשה וכ' he cast an eye at him and he was changed into &c., v. גַּל; Sabb. 34
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—Y. Ber. III, beg. 5
<sup>d</sup>, a. fr. נוֹתן תפלין puts on T’fillin.—נ' טעם, v. טַעַם.—הדין נותן the conclusion 
<italic>ad majus</italic> gives it, it is a legitimate conclusion. Bekh. 59
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. Ib. היא הנוֹתֶנֶת (on the contrary,) it is thus we should argue.—Gen. R. s. 33 והדין נותן and it stands to reason.—Esp. נ' (sub. דם) 
<italic>to put blood on the altar, sprinkle, smear</italic>. Zeb. VIII, 4; a. fr.—[Tosef. Neg. VI, 10 נותן, v. נָתַץ.]</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיתַּן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<sup>a</sup> לא ניתנה כתובה וכ' the K’thubah is not intended to be collected during life-time. R. Hash. 28
<sup>a</sup> מצות … נִיתְּנוּ, v. הָנָה; a. fr.—[Tosef. Ab. Zar. V (VI), 8 עד שינתן, v. נָתַץ.]—Esp. 
<italic>to be put on the altar, sprinkled, smeared</italic>. Zeb. VIII, 9 הנִתָּנִין למטה … בנתנין למעלה blood which must be put below (the red line) which has been mixed with blood that must be put above. Ib. 10 יִנָּתְנוּ במתן וכ' shall be applied four times, v. מַתָּן a. מַתָּנָה; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

Cant. R. to VIII, 6 (ref. to Jer. XXII, 24) שהוא נוֹתֵק מלכות וכ' that he will tear the Davidic kingdom out of his hand; ib. משם אני נותק וכ' from there I shall tear loose the kingdom &c.; Pesik. Shub., p. 163
<sup>a</sup>. Bekh. 33
<sup>b</sup> נותק he who tears loose (testicles and throws them away); נותק אחר כורת who removes them after one has cut them (tearing off the roots). Sifra Thazr., Neg., ch. VII, Par. 5 אם נְתָקוֹ אדם if a man made it bald (נֶתֶק); (R. S. to Neg. III, 5 אם נִיתְּקוּ בידי אדם, Nif.); a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. נָתוּק (b. h.) 
<italic>an animal whose testicles have been forcibly removed</italic>; [oth. opin.: 
<italic>whose membrum has been mutilated by a violent severance</italic>]. Sifra Emor, Par. 7, ch. VII; Tosef. Yeb. X, 5.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause oozing, to secrete</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ter. III, 13 ענבים רכות ונוֹתְקוֹת … ואינן נוֹתְקִין וכ' grapes are soft and let their juice ooze out (when packed), but olives are hard and do not let their oil ooze out.; Y. ib. III, 42
<sup>b</sup> top, v. דֵּיהֶא.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיתֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tear loose</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. l. c. (ref. to Jer. l. c.) אֲנַתֶּקְךָ אין … אֲתַקֶּנְךָ it does not say<italic>ănatteḳkha</italic> 
 (I shall tear thee loose), but (it may be read) 
<italic>atha</italic>
<italic>ḳḳ</italic>
<italic>enkha</italic> (I shall restore thee, v. תָּקַן); Yalk. Jer. 303 אַתֶּקְךָ (
<italic>Hif.</italic>); Pesik. l. c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to tear, pull</italic>] 
<italic>to remonstrate, protest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Num. 115; Yalk. Num. 750 התחיל הבן ההוא מְנַתֵּק that son began to protest (against doing slave’s work); התחילו ישראל מְנַתְּקִים the Israelites remonstrated (against the laws imposed upon them); v. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיתַּק, נִיתּוֹק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be torn loose; to fall out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 123
<sup>b</sup> שומר העשוי לִנָּתֵק מאליו a protection (cover) which it likely to come off of itself. Nidd. 65
<sup>a</sup> כיון שנִתְּקוּ שניו וכ' when a man’s teeth are gone; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>to tear one’s self loose</italic>,] 
<italic>to remonstrate, be discontented</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII גלוי … לִינָּתֵק בעריות it was known before the Lord that they would bear unwillingly the restrictive laws concerning sexual relations; נִיתְּקוּ בעריות they did remonstrate &c. (ref. to Num. XI, 10; v. Sabb. 130
<sup>a</sup>; Yoma 75
<sup>a</sup>); Yalk. Lev. 590.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be shifted, transformed, modified</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. 5
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. אשם שנ' לרעיה an animal dedicated as a guilt-offering which (on account of its owner’s death &c.) has been condemned to pasture until natural death (v. סָאַב).—Y. Naz. IV, end, 53
<sup>c</sup> משנ' מלא תעשה לעשה since it (the cutting of the hair which is forbidden to the Nazarite) has gone over from a prohibition to a positive duty (Num. VI, 18).—לאו שנ' לעשה a prohibition transformed into a command, i.e. a prohibitive law the transgression of which must be repaired by a succeeding act, e.g. (Lev. XIX, 13) ‘thou shalt not rob’, and (ib. V, 23) ‘he shall make restitution.’ Ḥull. 141
<sup>a</sup> (for which ib. XII, 4 מצות לא תעשה שיש בה קום עשה). Yoma 85
<sup>b</sup> לא תעשה שנ' לעשה; a. fr.—4) (v. Kal </notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to enter a stage of moist decomposition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Naz. VII, 56
<sup>b</sup>, v. נֵצֶל.—5) (denom. of נֶתֶק) 
<italic>to become hairless and blanched, to be afflicted with</italic> נֶתֶק. Neg. X, 9 ונ' כל ראשו and his entire head became bald (v. קָרַחַת). Sifra Thazr. l. c. את שני' נתק בתוך נתק a person that became afflicted with a bald spot within a patch of hair surrounded by baldness (Neg. X, 7 שני נְתָקִין זה לפנים מזה; a. fr.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<definition>

<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Koh. l. c.) פעמים מְסַבַּבְתָּן ופעמים מהלכתן (Rashi סוֹבַבְתָּן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) at seasons the sun goes around them (making a circuitous route), and at seasons it passes straight through (from north-east to south-west). Erub. 23
<sup>b</sup>; Num. R. s. 13 סַבֵּב tie around; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to be around a person, to wait upon</italic>. Deut. R. s. 1 (play on סב את ההר, Deut. II, 3) הרבה סי' עשו את הורו וכ' a long while has Esau been around his parent &c.—סי' על הפתחים 
<italic>to go around from door to door, to beg</italic>. Tosef. Peah IV, 8 המְסַבֵּב על … אין וכ' for the poor man that goes begging, the public charities are not bound to do anything. Y. ib. I, 15
<sup>d</sup> top כבד … אפי' את מסבב וכ' ‘honor thy father and thy mother’, even if thou have to go begging (thou must support them); Pesik. R. s. 23—24; a. e.—Ruth R. to I, 1 עכשיו … מְסַבְּבִין פתחי וכ' now all Israel will surround my gate …, waiting for distribution of food; Yalk. ib. 598 יהיו … מְסוּבִּין.</notes></sense>

<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to carry around from place to place.</italic></definition>

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to place around</italic>.</definition>

<italic>surrounded, closed</italic>. B. Bath. 25
<sup>b</sup>, v. אַכְסַדְרָא.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְסוּבִּים, מְסוּבִּין</plural-form>

<sup>b</sup> בני … מס' לשתות the members of a party that were assembled for a feast; ib. 102
<sup>a</sup>. Tosef. ib. X, 12; a. fr.—[Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 מסביב, read: מכתיב, v. כָּתַב.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<sup>a</sup> אבד סִבְרָן ובטל סכויין their prospect of restoration is gone &c. Erub. 21
<sup>b</sup> אבד סִבְרָם וכ' they are beyond hope (of return to God) &c. B. Mets. 33
<sup>b</sup> פסק סברם ובטל סכוים there is no hope for them &c.; Yalk. Is. 371 … שכרן … שיכויין (read שִׂבְרָן).</notes></sense>

<number>—2)</number>

<pgbrk id="pg953" />33

<sup>b</sup> איבעית אימא ס' ואב"א קרא I may say, it is founded on reason, or I may say, it is intimated in the Scriptures; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
